text: In recognition of the urgent need to expedite efforts to transform Toronto’s housing system, this report provides the Board of Directors, CreateTO with a broad update of 2026 housing-related priority work items: - Sites Under Construction (6 sites) - Sites with Secured Proponents (4 sites) - Sites in a Market Offering Process (1 sites) - Sites that have Received Initial Planning Approvals (8 sites) - Sites Undergoing Initial Planning Approvals (4 sites) - Sites Managed by Other City Partners (2 sites) A full list of projects can be found in Attachment 1 - Housing Tracker. In response to City Council direction through EX25.1 , in May 2026 the Housing Development Office will be bringing forward a three-year workplan and prioritization of the Toronto Builds portfolio to the Planning and Housing Committee.
The Board of Directors of CreateTO received the item for information.
